title: Helix Anthropis Institute Holds Inauguration Ceremony
summary: 31 July 2026 marked a defining milestone in the history of the Helix Anthropis Institute, with the signing of its Constitutional Act and its first Institutional Affiliation Agreement.
body:
## Establishing the Foundations of Helix

On 31 July 2026, the Helix Anthropis Institute (HAI) held its inauguration ceremony, formally marking the establishment of the organisation. The occasion was commemorated by the signing of the *Constitutional Act of the Helix Anthropis Institute*, the foundational document establishing the Institute's mission, governing principles, and institutional structure.

The Founder and Director of Helix, Martim Galésio, delivered a speech presenting the Institute as a bridge between the international frameworks established by institutions around the world and the societal actors whose actions contribute to their success qnd effectiveness. The address introduced Helix's mission:

> “[…] to promote and facilitate initiatives that contribute to the advancement of humanity and the common good without discrimination.”

*— Constitutional Act of the Helix Anthropis Institute, Chapter I, Article 2*

The speech also reaffirmed the values guiding the Institute's work and outlined its immediate priorities. Galésio emphasised that Helix's present focus is to consolidate its institutional foundations, establish its internal systems, and prepare the organisation for the launch of its central activities.

The Director further reaffirmed the 17 United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), established under the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, as the primary international framework guiding Helix's activities through the end of 2030.

The current Agenda is intended to reach its target horizon on 31 December 2030. In anticipation of the international community's transition towards a successor sustainable development framework, Helix intends to assess the evolving global agenda and adapt its institutional priorities accordingly from 1 January 2031.

Although the launch date of Helix's central activities has not yet been officially announced, the Institute currently anticipates commencing operations between November 2026 and January 2027.

## A Partnership for Sustainable Development

The inauguration ceremony also marked the signing of Helix's first Institutional Affiliation Agreement, establishing a formal relationship with the *Association des Jeunes pour les Objectifs de Développement Durable* (AJODD) of Luxembourg, one of the Institute's closest partners.

AJODD contributed to the organisation and moderation of the event and was represented by its former President and Vice-President, Mathieu Plaquevent and Timothy Panchaud, respectively.

Both representatives addressed the audience, highlighting AJODD's mission, the importance of sustainability, and the responsibility shared by individuals and organisations in advancing sustainable development. Their contributions emphasised a common principle underlying the work of both organisations: meaningful progress requires more than the recognition of global challenges; it requires people to take action.

During the ceremony, the President Mathieu Plaquevent expressed this principle in the following words:

> “[…] if we truly care about the future, we cannot remain spectators. We must become actors.”

*— Mathieu Plaquevent, former President of AJODD*

Timothy Panchaud reasserted the AJODD’s role in enabling action and recalled the public to the association’s philosophy :

> "If we believe our dreams can change the future for the better, we can and will achieve those dreams; and we saw that with AJODD."

*— Timothy Panchaud, Vice-President of AJODD*

The signing of the Institutional Affiliation Agreement represents an important step in formalising the relationship between the two organisations. It reflects their shared commitment to sustainable development and the advancement of the common good, while establishing a foundation for continued cooperation.

For Helix, collaboration with organisations already working towards these objectives is an important part of its approach. By building relationships with societal actors, the Institute seeks to contribute to a more coordinated and effective pursuit of international development priorities.

## Looking Ahead

The inauguration of the Helix Anthropis Institute represents a significant milestone in the development of an initiative built around research, collaboration, and action.

The signing of its Constitutional Act established the foundations of the Institute's institutional identity, while its first Institutional Affiliation Agreement marked an important step towards developing its network of partners.

Helix now enters a period focused on consolidating its foundations, developing its operational capacities, and preparing its central activities. As the international community approaches the conclusion of the 2030 Agenda, the Institute also recognises the importance of preparing for the next phase of global sustainable development cooperation.

Helix extends its gratitude to the partners, collaborators, and individuals whose contributions have helped bring the Institute to this stage of its development. Their participation reflects the collaborative effort required to turn shared ambitions into meaningful initiatives.

As it prepares for the next stage of its journey, Helix remains committed to promoting initiatives that advance humanity and contribute to the common good without discrimination.

Helix Anthropis Institute. Trust Helix with our mission.

title: WE'RE LOOKING FOR WORLD CHANGERS
summary: Wonna help change the world in a meaningful and impactful manner? Come work with us in uniting humanity towards a brighter future!
body:
Have you ever felt like the world could be better if everyone stood together? We agree with you and want to help humanity evolve together - our main philosophy! 

Helix is here to help everyone, from NGOs to businesses, participate actively in changing the world and make it profitable and impactful! 

We believe it is important for everyone to participate in the making of a better world, including those who just started. Which is why we provide services essential to develop their professional activity such as professional advice, higher visibility and outreach, networking opportunities, and a lot more - all completely for free.

We’re looking to make this organization a Hub where anyone can participate in creating a better world and grow their professional activity faster and better.
To bring this to a reality, we’re looking for people to fulfil many different positions :

 - Head of Operations (managing relationships with costumers, managing our primary financial project, etc….)

 - Head of Visibility Office (managing social media, website, advertisement campaigns, facilitating networking events, radio station and discord server, etc….)

 - Advisors/Liaison Officers (our personalised costumer service for managing relationships with clients in their Member Portfolio and participate in projects and missions when assigned to task forces)

 - HR Agents (handle the normal hiring, training, firing and exceptional situations, maintaining a complex training system that ensures our volunteers actually learn and that ensures the quality of their work)

 - Creative Team members (Videographer, Graphic Designer, Campaign Manager, etc…)


These are some of the many roles that we have available and we have a lot more. Our organization is highly complex, our environment is dynamic and our work is professional. 

If want to make a real change in the world, come work for the Helix Anthropis Institute.

Helix Anthropis Institute. Trust us with your impact.
